summary.intent: Implement two new test packages — SDK-driven E2E tests (no browser) and SDK-driven load tests — as a replacement for flaky Playwright E2E tests, using the existing CipherBoxClient as the test driver.
summary.outcome: Both packages (`tests/sdk-e2e/` with 83 passing tests across 10 suites, and `tests/load/` with 5 load scenarios) were created, a throttle bypass mechanism was implemented for the API, CI workflows were added, and multiple rounds of automated PR review comments were fully resolved.

repo: `setApiClientConfig` is a module-level singleton because orval generates standalone functions that import `customInstance` directly — there is no class context to hold per-instance config. This forces all consumers to share one global config, causing cross-contamination in multi-account tests.

The API throttler is applied per-controller via `@UseGuards(ThrottlerGuard)`, not globally via APP_GUARD. Per-endpoint `@Throttle()` decorators override the controller-level limit; the IPNS publish endpoint has a 10 req/min limit which is the direct cause of 429s during load tests.

The API `.env` file contains `NODE_ENV=development`, which takes precedence over shell-level env var exports because `ConfigModule.forRoot()` loads dotenv before NestJS resolves process.env — you cannot override it without editing the file.

API controller unit test specs use `.overrideGuard(ThrottlerGuard)` targeting `@nestjs/throttler`'s class — when controllers were updated to import `BypassableThrottlerGuard as ThrottlerGuard`, the override stopped working and all 8 affected spec files required updating.
`node apps/api/dist/main.js` does not load `.env` automatically; `pnpm --filter api dev` (nest start --watch) does. Standalone compiled output requires explicit env sourcing.
The `pnpm-workspace.yaml` has three package groups: `apps/*`, `packages/*`, and `tests/*` — new test packages must be placed under `tests/` to be workspace members.

Vitest v3 does not support `--testPathPattern` as a CLI flag (that is a Jest flag). The workflow was passing it via `-- --testPathPattern=...` which vitest silently ignored, causing all scenarios to run on every manual trigger.

code.finding: Canonical test harness pattern: POST /auth/test-login → initializeVault → encryptVaultKeys → POST /vault/init → setApiClientConfig → new CipherBoxClient → registerFolder. Extracted into reusable `createTestAccount()` and `createTestContext()` in tests/sdk-e2e/src/fixtures/test-harness.ts.

`createAxiosInstance` was not applying `defaultHeaders` from the config — it only used `baseUrl` and `getAccessToken`. The bypass header injected via `setApiClientConfig({ defaultHeaders })` was therefore not reaching outbound axios requests until this was fixed.

New `BypassableThrottlerGuard` extends `ThrottlerGuard`. Uses `Buffer.from` byte-length comparison (not string length) for timing-safe comparison of the bypass secret to avoid non-ASCII false negatives. Includes `NODE_ENV !== 'production'` guard so the bypass can never activate in production even if the secret leaks.

`crypto.getRandomValues()` has a hard 65,536 byte limit per call. Files larger than 64KB must be filled in chunks. The original implementation crashed silently for the 100KB–500KB test files, showing as all-rejected clients with no error message.

The `setApiClientConfig` singleton is overwritten by multi-account test fixtures (share-operations, invite-link). Error-cases runs after those and its `createFolder` call (which routes through sdk-core → api-client singleton) used the last-set token. Fixed by calling `setApiClientConfig` with `ctx`'s token at the top of the event-emission test block.

The original `aggregateAndReport` helper computed throughput using wall-clock aggregation time rather than the actual time span of collected samples. Fixed to derive duration from `max(endTime) - min(startTime)` across all samples.

workflow: 1Password SSH agent for commit signing times out in background subprocesses during long sessions — commits from background agents may need to be retried or run from the user's terminal.

When load test workloads use `metrics.measure()` (which re-throws after recording), all error handling must be inside the try/catch block — errors before the `metrics.measure` call crash the workload silently and show as 'rejected' in `Promise.allSettled` with no message unless explicitly logged.

Raw `fetch()` calls in test suites bypass the axios singleton and therefore miss any `defaultHeaders` (like the throttle bypass secret). A `testFetch()` wrapper that merges default headers is the short-term fix; migrating to the generated API client functions is the proper long-term fix.
When debugging silent load test failures, add explicit rejection reason logging to `Promise.allSettled` result handling — the default behavior discards rejection reasons entirely.

Vitest's `--reporter` flag and positional file/pattern arguments work correctly; the correct way to filter scenarios for `pnpm test -- <pattern>` is to pass the pattern as a positional arg, not as `--testPathPattern`.

friction: 1Password SSH agent timed out multiple times during background bash tool commits, requiring retries and user intervention.
API `.env` `NODE_ENV=development` silently overrode shell env var, causing the `NODE_ENV=test` throttle-relaxation attempt to have no effect until the file was manually edited.
Updating all 8 API controller spec files to override `BypassableThrottlerGuard` instead of `ThrottlerGuard` was discovered only after CI failure, not caught locally before push.
`crypto.getRandomValues` 65,536 byte limit caused all upload-throughput load test clients to fail silently — no error surface without explicit `Promise.allSettled` rejection logging.
Multiple rounds of `sed`/`replace_all` edits to add the `fetchHeaders` wrapper in `vault-lifecycle.test.ts` corrupted the file (mismatched closing parens) and required a full rewrite.
The `setApiClientConfig` singleton cross-contamination between test suites was discovered at test runtime, not during development — required a targeted per-test re-set workaround.

CodeRabbit flagged `--testPathPattern` as invalid in an early review and was marked 'not applicable' in error — the flag is indeed invalid in Vitest and silently ignored, requiring a follow-up fix after later review.
open_items: Refactor `@cipherbox/api-client` from module-level singleton to instance-scoped axios: configure orval to generate functions accepting an axios instance, thread the instance through `SdkContext` in sdk-core, have CipherBoxClient own its axios instance. Tracked in `.planning/todos/pending/2026-03-22-refactor-api-client-from-singleton-to-instance-scoped-axios.md`.

Investigate throttle bypass gap for per-endpoint `@Throttle()` decorators: IPNS publish endpoint (10 req/min) still returns 429 during load tests despite the bypass guard. Root cause unclear — may be header not reaching the IPNS controller, or 429 originating from upstream IPFS. Tracked in `.planning/todos/pending/2026-03-22-investigate-throttle-bypass-gap-for-per-endpoint-throttle-decorators.md`.

Migrate raw `fetch()` calls in vault-lifecycle, share-operations, and invite-link test suites to use generated API client functions — this would automatically propagate `defaultHeaders` and eliminate the `testFetch()` helper.
Load tests against staging have not been run — the manual dispatch `load-test.yml` workflow is ready but requires `STAGING_THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET` to be set as a GitHub Actions secret for staging.
Add a 'throttle validation' load scenario that deliberately runs without the bypass header, to verify the throttler itself works correctly under load — needed for staging single-node perf baseline.
